annotations.title: Act counts by type, period and province

description:
Count BORME acts by act type, period (month, quarter or year) and
province: how many companies and entries had mergers, spin-offs, capital
increases or any other act type, newest period first.

Use it for trends ("mergers per quarter in Spain since 2020"). To read
the acts themselves use search_events.

Returns JSON {grain, count, truncated, rows: [{period, act_type, province,
companies, events}], data_through, built_from, built_to, note,
plan_window}, plus hidden_by_plan when the plan left buckets out, and
not_built (no rows, never zeros) when the range reaches years outside
built_from..built_to. period is the bucket's first day by BORME
publication date. companies counts distinct companies in that bucket:
never add rows up. Province "*" is all of Spain; a community gives one row
per province, not a total.

Read-only; one request per call. Needs the pro plan or higher: send your
key in the X-API-Key header (https://bormeapi.com/account).

act_types.description: Optional list of act type enums to count, e.g. ["MERGER_BY_ABSORPTION", "TOTAL_SPIN_OFF"]; omit for every act type. Full list: list_act_types.
act_types.title: Act Types

by_province.description: Without provinces: true gives one row per province instead of the all-provinces rows, e.g. true (default false).
by_province.title: By Province

date_from.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2024-01-01; the period holding this day is the first one. Data starts on 2009-01-02.
date_from.title: Date From

date_to.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2025-12-31; periods starting on or before this day.
date_to.title: Date To

grain.description: The length of each period, one of "month" (default), "quarter", "year", e.g. "quarter".
grain.title: Grain

limit.description: Maximum rows, integer 1-5000, e.g. 200 (default 1000); truncated is true when more matched.
limit.title: Limit

provinces.description: Optional list of BORME province names, accent- and case-insensitive, e.g. ["MADRID", "BARCELONA"]; an autonomous community gives one row per province, e.g. ["Cataluña"]. Omit for the all-provinces rows (province "*").
